title: Harbor：成员与权限的三种管理方式
Harbor: three ways to manage members and access
summary: 同一个成员页，分别把改动后果、批量效率和邀请上手放在最前面。
One members page, leading with the consequences of a change, bulk speed, or inviting and onboarding.
brief: 为一个小型团队的共享工作区重做成员页：邀请、改角色、移除成员、撤回邀请。
Redesign the members page of a small-team workspace: invite, change roles, remove members, revoke invites.

optimizes: 权限变更的确定性：常驻角色说明，每次改角色/移除都在行内暂存，并以 +获得 / −失去 列出后果后再应用。
Certainty about permission changes: role descriptions stay visible, and every role change or removal is staged inline with what is gained and lost before it applies.
tradeoff: 每次改角色都多一步确认；左侧说明栏占宽，信息密度最低，成员多时需要滚动。
One extra confirmation per role change; the description column takes width, density is lowest, and long member lists need scrolling.
bestFor: 5–30 人团队、偶尔管理成员的 Owner，或内容敏感、改错权限代价高的工作区。
Owners of 5–30 person teams who manage members occasionally, or workspaces where a wrong permission is costly.

alt: 衬线标题、常驻角色说明栏与成员列表
Serif headline, a permanent role guide and the member list

optimizes: 批量与审计速度：搜索（/ 快捷键）、带计数的角色筛选、闲置 ≥7 天标记、可排序列、一次粘贴多个邮箱批量邀请；只有升为 Admin 和移除才弹窗确认。

Speed for bulk work and audits: search with the / key, role filters with counts, idle-for-7-days flags, sortable columns and pasting several emails to invite at once; only promotion to Admin and removal ask for confirmation.
tradeoff: 密集深色界面对偶尔使用的人有压迫感；角色说明藏在弹窗里，降级不预先说明后果（只靠撤销）。
A dense dark interface can feel heavy for occasional users; role descriptions live in a dialog and demotions apply without previewing consequences, relying on undo.
bestFor: 30 人以上、需要季度权限审查或频繁增删成员的团队，由熟练管理员操作。
Teams of 30+ with quarterly access reviews or frequent membership changes, run by experienced admins.

alt: 深色成员表，带搜索、角色筛选和闲置标记
Dark member table with search, role filters and idle flags

optimizes: 邀请与上手：邀请是首屏主角，角色用白话卡片选择；成员按角色分栏，一眼看出谁能做什么；单人所有操作集中在一个对话框。

Inviting and onboarding: the invite is the first-screen focus with plain-language role cards; members are grouped in columns by role so who-can-do-what is visible at a glance; everything about one person lives in one dialog.
tradeoff: 密度最低，超过约 15 人时分栏高度失衡、难以扫描；改角色要先打开对话框，多一次点击；无搜索。
Lowest density: past about 15 people the columns become uneven and hard to scan; changing a role takes an extra click through the dialog; no search.
bestFor: 刚组建的小团队、首次邀请协作者的创始人，或不熟悉权限概念的管理员。
Newly formed small teams, founders inviting collaborators for the first time, or admins unfamiliar with permission concepts.

alt: 首屏邀请区与按角色分栏的成员卡片
Invite area up front, with member cards grouped by role

reason: Harbor 面向小型团队、成员页低频使用，最大风险是改错权限而非操作慢；A 在每次变更前展示获得/失去的能力，并常驻角色说明。这是基于产品描述的假设，尚未经过用户测试；若团队规模超过约 30 人或需要定期权限审计，B 更合适。

Harbor serves small teams and the members page is used rarely, so the main risk is a wrong permission, not slowness. A shows what is gained and lost before every change and keeps role descriptions visible. This is an assumption from the product description, not tested with users; for teams above about 30 people or regular access audits, B fits better.
